lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance pixel clusters arranged in approximately four vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with the highest concentration of distinct centroids located in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with high-luminance circular blobs to form a discernible grid-like pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper lateral flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, featuring high-luminance peaks on the superior edges and shadow troughs on the inferior edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped indentation on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin and a high-luminance white appendage or artifact trailing from the posterior-ventral edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical gill slits on the anterior lateral section exhibiting high-contrast internal shadowing against the surrounding dermal tissue.
